flat_reason: ledger present, no open/partial/orphan episodes, no live orders, no live/unresolved/booked exposure

expectancy.method: n/a (need >=2 closed trades); descriptive only, not a promotion gate

booked.funding_rule: equal split among episodes holding an open remainder at the funding timestamp; funding with no open episode attributes to the day only
booked.slippage_note: slippage is implicit in booked fill prices vs arrival; no separate booked slippage leg exists. Estimated adverse costs live in the estimates section only.

estimates.note: cost-contract-v1 estimates computed at report time from entry notionals; recorded separately, never booked, spread charged once (half per leg).

reconciliation.identity: booked.net = realized episodes + unlinked fills + day-level funding (open basis is unrealized inventory, disclosed separately, never in net)

account_check.gap_is: unrealized mark delta on open remainders plus anything unmodeled; zero when flat with no unlinked fills.

daily_realized_note: realized only (closed/partial economics + sunk episode fees + funding) by Asia/Kolkata day; zero-trade days preserved from the equity window.
daily_marked_note: first/last equity marks per Asia/Kolkata day; includes unrealized, never booked as P&L.

funnel_stages.usable_data_note: clock-second union across strategies; use usable_symbol_seconds_total as the denominator for symbol-time coverage.
funnel_stages.strategy_eligible_note: symbol-seconds per strategy (sum over instruments); see eligible_symbol_seconds for attribution.
